title: BMW Canada newsroom - Shell Recharge integration and access to NACS Superchargers (2026-04-08)
notes: Most current BMW and MINI BEVs get Supercharger access by software update and the Lectron Vortex Plus NACS-to-CCS adapter, except the original BMW i3 (I01) and MINI Cooper SE (F56); all-new 2026+ models such as iX3 and i3 have a built-in NACS port.
